expectedCandidates.why: msg.sender.call{value} at line 41, balances[msg.sender] -= amount only at line 43 — the receiving contract can re-enter before the balance decreases.
Writes sensitive state owner with no onlyOwner modifier and no require(msg.sender == owner) — anyone can seize ownership.
address(this).balance / totalShares with no require(totalShares > 0) — reverts when the vault is empty, share price undefined.
The ecrecover result is used with no check that signer != address(0) — an invalid signature yields address(0).
require(tx.origin == owner) — authorization via tx.origin, can be lured through an intermediary contract / phishing.
to.call{value: amount}("") result ignored, then feeBps zeroed as if the transfer succeeded.
Writes sensitive state feeBps + sends ETH to an arbitrary address with no modifier / access require — anyone can call it.
Digest is only (msg.sender, amount) with no nonce / chainId / address(this) — one valid owner signature can be reused without limit (Kiro finding B).
The zero-signer check fixes bug 4, but the digest still has no nonce — replay still works (Kiro finding B).
Digest (owner, spender, value, deadline) with no nonce / chainId — a self-signed signature can be replayed; plus arbitrary mint (Kiro findings A/B).
balances decreased, but shares / totalShares not — share accounting out of sync (Kiro finding C).
CEI is correct, but shares / totalShares still not decreased on withdrawal (Kiro finding C).
require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount) commented out inside the function — the balance check is disabled, withdrawal without balance passes validation (AMP-01 class, Amply).
Function setFeePaused commented out in full — no path can change feeBps (AMP-02 class, Amply, setDebtCeiling commented out in full).
latestAnswer() used as-is; only a price > 0 check (not staleness) — if the feed stalls, the stale price is still used (AMP-06 class, Amply; exact AaveOracle upstream shape).
IPriceOracleGetter.getAssetPrice used directly for collateral valuation with no check on price age (AMP-06 shape on the consumer side — Amply ValidationLogic.validateBorrow).

onlyHandler (caller = router, not trader) but checks `affiliate == msg.sender` as if msg.sender were the trader — vacuous check, self-referral passes (FUL-REF-01 class, Fulcrom ReferralManager, BB afternoon session 15 Nov 2026).
feeBps written in payFee (feeBps = 0) + setFeeCommentProse (feeBps = bps) but never read — the vault never uses the fee; dead config present in the fixture from the start, only caught by detector 17.

configDead written in the setter but never read — governance thinks the config applies, but no logic uses it (R-02 class, Fulcrom VaultPriceFeedV2 favorPrimaryPrice, BB afternoon session 15 Nov 2026).
thresholdDead written in the setter but never read — second R-02 shape (Fulcrom spreadThresholdBasisPoints).

dispatch(bytes) external with no guard executes to.call{value: call.value}(call.data) with target+data decoded from calldata — H3 class, Hyperbridge CallDispatcher.dispatch (BB afternoon session 17 Nov 2026, referee Medium, Foundry PoC-verified 4/4).

uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(dispatcher) then transfer(address(this), balance) — sweep of the intermediary contract's full balance, not the declared amount — H3b class, Hyperbridge IntentGatewayV2.placeOrder (BB afternoon session 17 Nov 2026, referee Low).

drainValue(to, amount) external with no guard: (bool ok,) = to.call{value: amount}("") with the return checked — escapes unchecked-call (return captured) and permissionless-dispatcher (empty data); F8 class, Kiro review 17 Nov 2026.
payFee(to, amount) external with no guard: to.call{value: amount}("") to a caller-chosen address — same ETH drain as BUG 21 (already flagged missing-access-control + unchecked-call).

if (len > 0) skips verifyProof when parachains is empty, state.latestHeight still advances in verify(), honest proofs for the same block are rejected by the stale check — K-1 class, Hyperbridge EcdsaBeefy (censors one interval, liveness).

accrueReward adds to totalPooledEth without minting shares, stake mints at the pre-accrual rate, requestUnbond locks the post-accrual rate then burns shares; unbondingFee default 0 — VENO-C2 class, YbEth (BB morning session 19 Nov 2026, referee Medium, Foundry PoC-verified 4/4). Status: GUGUR — hostile review 19 Nov 2026 (out of scope, dilution exclusion); will not be submitted.

bridge() forwards the user's ERC20 deposit to bridgehub.requestL2TransactionTwoBridges (contract recorded as deposit sender); existing withdraws cover only the base token (via lookup) + ETH to treasury, with no arbitrary ERC20 rescue and no receive()/fallback() — VENO-C1 class, BridgeMiddleware zkCRO (BB morning session 19 Nov 2026, latent candidate, mock PoC 5/5 PASS; 0 victims, never submitted).

The ITEM_OTHER branch in decodeHeader only sets a flag without reading the Vec<u8> payload from the slice, while the CONSENSUS/SEAL branches read the payload via decodeItem(slice) — offset desync for the next item; the other field is never filled — L-1 class, Hyperbridge Codec.DecodeHeader (BB morning session 20 Nov 2026, Info/design, NOT a submission candidate — the header must be genuinely finalized).
NavGuardTrap.previewRedeem reads NAV via _nav() with no locked check, while totalAssets() guards with require(!locked) — H-SOMM-12 class, Somm Cellar (latent/hardening).

VestingBloatTrap.vestedBalanceOf loops over all of allUserDepositIds[user].values() without a bound, while public deposit() with no guard adds to that set with a free receiver — H-SOMM-19 class, Somm VestingSimple (fork PoC: totalAssets bricks at ±3,121 entries).
